entities.name: Ovalchase
entities.description: One of Ghirapur's most iconic districts, centered on a high-speed racetrack frequented by pilots, inventors and gamblers.

entities.name: Ghirapur
entities.description: City on Kaladesh that contains Ovalchase.

entities.name: Consulate
entities.description: Officials who maintain the racetrack and whose enforcers clash with renegades elsewhere in the city.

entities.name: Hall of Mechanists
entities.description: Building near the track honoring racing legends, with a statue of an angel.

entities.name: Kaladesh
entities.description: The plane of inventors on which Ghirapur lies.

events.summary: A radiant sun angel appears and is said to have decided the outcome of a pivotal race, honored by a statue in the Hall of Mechanists.
events.quote: the miraculous appearance of a radiant sun angel was said to have decided the outcome of a pivotal race

relations.quote: Ovalchase is one of Ghirapur 's most iconic districts
The racetrack itself is officially maintained by the Consulate
